content.text:
Broadly yes: all of them let the model search the code itself. None builds a semantic (embedding) index to pick files. They differ in how smart their search tools are.

| | Our harness | Claude Code | NVIDIA NOOA | Nemotron |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| How it finds files | `grep`, `glob`, `read` (ripgrep) | Same idea: Grep, Glob, Read, Bash | Code search plus **symbol tools**: `symbols()` (definitions via tree-sitter), `refs()` (usages), a **repo map** of files with their top-level functions and classes | Not a harness; depends on which one runs it |
| Code index / map | None | None by default; optional **code-intelligence plugins** (language servers) add go-to-definition and type errors | Repo map and symbol lists computed on demand, not a stored embedding index | Its guide uses OpenCode, OpenHands, Kilo Code, OpenClaw |
| Read before edit | Yes (`fs-observation-policy`) | Yes (Edit fails unless the file was read) | Not checked | Depends on the harness |
| Project instructions | `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` | `CLAUDE.md` | Not checked | Depends on the harness |
| Help for big searches | Subagents, plan mode | Explore subagent, plan mode | Model writes Python to search and filter | Depends on the harness |

**Sources for this table:**
- **Claude Code:** its docs say the language-server plugins give "precise symbol navigation instead of text-based search," and one go-to-definition call can replace a grep plus several reads. The Grep, Glob, Read and read-before-edit behavior are the tools I use in this session.
- **NOOA:** from `packages/nooa-cli/src/nooa_cli/tools/repo_tools.py` in NVIDIA's repo (`symbols`, `refs`, `_repo_map`, tree-sitter with a regex fallback).
- **Nemotron:** only a model. Which file it edits depends entirely on the harness around it.

**Where ours stands:** it relies only on text search. The other two add symbol-aware navigation (definitions, references, a file-and-function map), which helps in big codebases where the right file doesn't contain your keywords.

**If you want the same:** a symbol tool or repo map would be the matching feature, either tree-sitter based like NOOA or language-server based like Claude Code's plugins. It would be a new tool plugin, not a change to the agent loop.
